about: Hand-written from the October 5, 2026 research brief. Entries marked to confirm were not verified for the current game. Nothing was scraped.

events.name: Magic Square and Secret Peak free entries
events.summary: Free portal entries reset at 16:00 UTC, which is 00:00 in UTC+8. The same guide caps gold recharge at 2 per day.

events.name: Domination, morning
events.summary: One entry per day, at the Tower of Black Dragon. This is the first of three regional windows.

events.name: Domination, afternoon
events.summary: One entry per day. This is the second regional window.

events.name: Domination, night
events.summary: One entry per day. This window runs past midnight.

events.name: Nerkan sealed spawn
events.summary: World boss Nerkan appears sealed on random servers.

events.name: Nerkan fight
events.summary: Nerkan becomes fightable. The path cited is Black Flame Abaddon via Redmoon 4F.

events.name: Turkan fight
events.summary: Turkan becomes fightable. The path cited is Violet Abaddon via Phantasia 4F.

events.name: Some clan shop tickets
events.summary: The portal guide says some clan shop tickets reset their purchase limit on Monday at 00:00 UTC+8. It does not say every clan shop item resets then.

events.name: Boosting World IV maintenance
events.summary: Official notices run Boosting World IV from August 18, 2026, 17:00 UTC+8, through the January 5, 2027 maintenance. They name the end date and do not give the hour. This countdown uses 00:00 PHT, and the hour is to confirm.

events.name: Attack of the Living Wraiths
events.note: Post 233, an older official post, lists Thursday 22:00–23:00 regional server time. The research brief says to reconfirm this in the 2026 client, so it is marked to confirm.

events.name: Magic Square Leaders Chamber III
events.summary: A 2022 community guide lists fixed ASIA hours. Those hours are not treated as current.
events.note: GameWith, August 2022, lists Leaders Chamber III at 00:00, 03:00, 06:00, 09:00, 12:00, 15:00, 18:00, and 21:00 ASIA. The research brief treats that table as community-derived and unverified for the current client.

events.name: Secret Peak bosses
events.note: The official portal page says bosses appear at regular intervals and does not publish a clock. Community pages cite different hours, so this page does not pick a time.

events.name: Castle Siege
events.summary: No next date and no countdown.
events.note: Official notes describe Castle Siege about every four weeks on Sunday, with an Eve from Monday through Saturday before it. Post 2644 uses September 27, 2026 as an example, and that date has passed. A community citation of the siege FAQ (post 1093) gives 22:00–23:00. That hour is not used for a countdown.

events.name: Reset of every daily task at 17:00
events.summary: Not used for the checklist reset.
events.note: A wiki claim that every daily resets at 17:00 ASIA was not confirmed. The wiki page errored when the brief was written. This clock does not count down to 17:00.

plannerPicks.label: This is a Castle Siege week for me
plannerPicks.note: The next siege date is not verified. Tick this only if you already know it is your siege week.

plannerPicks.label: Mission Scroll claim this week
plannerPicks.note: Post 2655 describes a rollover around September 30, 2026, 23:55 UTC+8 into October 1, 2026, about 00:30 UTC+8. That window has passed. The next Mission Scroll window is to confirm.
